description: Create a used car comparison spreadsheet to help a friend make a quick purchasing decision. Add column headers: Vehicle, Year, Mileage, Price, Cost_Per_Mile, Notes. Enter data for 4 vehicles (Honda Civic, Toyota Corolla, Mazda3, Ford Focus). Create formulas in the Cost_Per_Mile column: =Price/(150000-Mileage) to calculate cost per remaining mile. Add brief notes for each vehicle. Save as /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/car_comparison.xlsx
